title: Engine integration tests - determinism/null, bypass, Mix=0 passthrough, mono-lows invariant, latency report
description:
Author tests/EngineTests.cpp only. Prove ShredWidthEngine integration invariants from Build Spec §14 without owning CMakeLists (c.3 registers this file).

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.h API from c.1
- tests/TestMain.cpp and tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp harness style from phase B
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §14 items 2–5, 9 (determinism, bypass, Mix=0, mono-lows, latency report)

Implement focused engine-level tests in tests/EngineTests.cpp:
1. Determinism / null: identical input + params over two runs produces bit-identical (or exact float-equal) output checksum/buffers — guards hidden state.
2. Bypass / true dry path policy: with engine/processor bypass semantics available at engine level (mix=0 or explicit bypass if exposed), output matches dry input delayed by reported latency where applicable; document whether test drives engine-only or a minimal AudioProcessor fixture. Prefer engine-only if bypass lives above engine — then assert Mix=0 path strictly.
3. Mix=0 passthrough: wet path silenced; out == original input delayed by getReportedLatencySamples() (integer dry-align ⇒ sample-exact).
4. Mono-lows invariant: stimulus is a sub-f_cross sine (e.g. 100 Hz with xover 180 Hz); for width in {0, 1, 2} assert L(n) == R(n) within FP epsilon across a block after settling — proves shared-LP assembly + M/S cannot move lows.
5. Latency report: Studio ⇒ 1024, Live ⇒ 256 via getReportedLatencySamples(); switching mode updates the reported value (and does not require re-prepare realloc).

Use the existing test runner entry (TestMain). Do not edit CMakeLists, PluginProcessor, or DSP sources. Keep tests deterministic and allocation-light.
acceptance_criteria: tests/EngineTests.cpp exists and is wired for the phase-B test runner style
EngineTests covers determinism (two identical runs match) for ShredWidthEngine
EngineTests covers Mix=0 passthrough aligned to reported PDC latency
EngineTests covers mono-lows invariant L==R for sub-f_cross sine across width {0,1,2}
EngineTests asserts getReportedLatencySamples is 1024 (Studio) and 256 (Live) and updates on mode switch
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify tests/TestMain.cpp or tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp unless strictly required (prefer EngineTests only)

allowed: engine-only fixtures without full PluginProcessor if simpler
small helper to fill sine buffers and compare with epsilon
settle/skip initial latency samples before mono-lows asserts
forbidden: rewrite engine DSP in the test file
